scenario: A payroll approval screen opens with a large animated 3D scene that delays locating the pending approvals.

review.summary: The performative hero consumes the hierarchy needed for an approval task.

findings.title: Animation dominates the approval task
findings.observation: The animation occupies most of the first viewport before pending approvals.
findings.product_mismatch: Approvers need to scan and act on pending payroll items promptly.

evidence.fact: The hero is taller than the visible approval list.

findings.revision_constraint: Restore task hierarchy without treating expressive motion as categorically wrong.
